Objective: Minimize makespan:

MachineA, 3 time units) → Step 2 (Ma-chineB, 2 time units) → Step 3 (MachineC, 2 time units) • Job2: Step 1 (MachineA, 2 time units) → Step 2 (Ma-chineC, 1 time unit) → Step 3 (MachineB, 4 time units) • Job3: Step 1 (MachineB, 4 time units) → Step 2 (Ma-chineA, 1 time unit) → Step 3 (MachineC, 3 time units) Rules: (1) Each job must perform its steps strictly in order (e.g., Job1's Step 2 can only begin after Step 1 finishes). (2) Each machine can only handle one operation at a time (e.g., while MachineA is running Job1-Op1 from time 0-3, it cannot process any other operation). Objective: Create a schedule listing each step's start time, end time, machine, and job, ensuring all jobs finish in minimum total time. Format: Time Interval | Task Name | Machine | Job Example: 0-3 | Job1-Op1 | MachineA | Job1 Reactive Event: At time 𝑡 = 4, MachineA breaks down and is unavailable from 𝑡 = 4 to 𝑡 = 6. Adjust the schedule accordingly, ensuring: (1) Step precedence is respected. (2) No two operations use the same machine at the same time.
